image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured surface of damp earth, decaying leaves, and small twigs. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and stripes. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the limbs are short and stout. The tail extends towards the right edge of the frame.
